title: Ktlint-gradle (org.jlleitschuh.gradle.ktlint) with ktlint 1.8.0 incompatible with Kotlin 2.4.20

<!---Tell us what should happen. -->

<!-- Note: Ktlint should not produce any code which conflict with IntelliJ default code formatting. So please verify that your expectation is accepted by IntelliJ default code formatting. -->

## Observed Behavior
Fails when formatting with ktlint 2.4.20 in a spring project. 

## Steps to Reproduce
Upgrading project from 2.4.10 -> 2.4.20
`Extensions storage is not registered`
